test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A cock and bull story
solution:
The correct answer is "**A foolish and concocted story."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A cock and bull story means a far-fetched and unbelievable tale. (बेतुकी और गढ़ी हुई कहानी)
